summary.en: An L2 penalty on the coefficients that stabilises estimates when predictors are strongly correlated, at the cost of some bias.
A family of biased shrinkage estimators introduced by Liu, used as an alternative to ridge under multicollinearity.
L1 and combined L1/L2 penalties that shrink coefficients and can set some exactly to zero, for variable selection in high dimensions.
Partial least squares structural equation modelling, which estimates relationships between latent constructs.
Repeated simulated samples used to compare the bias and variability of estimators.
